title: Polynomial space languages
statement: The class $\mathrm{PSPACE}$ consists of all languages over the Boolean alphabet that are decidable using space at most $n^c+1$ for some natural number $c$, where $n$ is the input length.
hypotheses_covered: A natural-number exponent $c$ is chosen for each language
